native_mechanisms: Eight violin strings bound under one bridge on the counting-bars: a single pluck shivers into every other string — cross-lane coupled mixing engine.
A fresh, never-reused feather per mark records only the mark's ink-weight (not its shape), fixing strict order into the running count — per-position table lookup of each byte.
A single storm pass over the final tremor collapses it into one small fixed token, after which all feathers and drops are destroyed — one-shot finalizer plus discard of intermediate state.
core_technique: 8-lane simple tabulation (Zobrist) hashing: each byte indexes a position-rotated 256-entry random table and is accumulated by addition into one of 8 independent lanes with per-lane rotations, then lanes are combined and run through a Murmur3 fmix64 finalizer (bytes are never multiplied in the kernel, unlike FNV-1a/xxHash).
